definitions: To make a soft, murmuring sound, typically used to call calves or other animals.
To suckle or draw milk from the breast or udder.
To move or go slowly and reluctantly; to dawdle.
To complain or whine in a petulant way; to sulk.
examples: The farmer would sook his calves in from the field.
The lamb sooked at its mother's udder.
Don't sook around, get your work done.
